title: inulanthera tridens
intro: Inulanthera tridens, commonly known as the 'Golden Flower' or 'Yellow Buttons', is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Inulanthera tridens include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
